facts: Parties: Galloway Robotics Ltd (Buyer), Corrib Foods Ltd (Seller); the Company is Ingleby Media Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 29 November 2026; Closing is scheduled for 8 February 2027 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 150 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 29 November 2026), either party may terminate.
Section 9.7: the Buyer must notify any warranty claim within 30 days of becoming aware of it.

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 12 June 2027.
Clause 5.2: a claim against the Escrow Amount must be notified within 45 days of the Buyer becoming aware of it.

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Redcliffe Logistics plc. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
Item 5: the board noted a letter before action from Bellhaven Pharma plc threatening proceedings for approximately $1,200,000 in respect of alleged defective deliveries. Management to monitor.
